scope: XAUUSD 2025 full and 2026 data pinned March 26 - September 25 only
method: OHLC M1=>M1/M5/M15/M30, fixed costs $0.8/$1.2/$1.6 per ounce, stop-first, one position, next open, quarter flatten, 1.5ATR stop 2R target, timeout24 bars, NY signal 12-17 UTC

model_definitions.BREAK_BOTH: Previous confirmed 20-bar breakout aligned EMA21/55/200; close on VWAP correct side, body >=0.30 and RVOL >=.90
model_definitions.PULL_BOTH: EMA21/55/200 aligned, VWAP confirmed, EMA21 touch/reclaim 0.18/0.10 ATR, directional candle >=.20 body, both directions

fixed_screen_pre_committed: 2025>=40 trades PF>1.10 all 2025 quarters >=3 positive; 2026_partial>=20 trades PF>1.10 points>0; stress 1.6 positive; no adjustment after results
material_limits: Not a MT5 broker real-tick backtest or money performance
Public historical volume differs from MetaTrader broker tick volume, affecting VWAP and RVOL
Cost assumptions exclude dynamic spreads, commission, slippage, financing, execution latency, contract sizing and broker constraints
Quarter boundaries force position closing; the EA does not force quarterly liquidation
EMA and ATR initial seed differences possible; EA stop/expiration approximates replay but not exact
2025 and 2026 historical observations are not truly unseen, no forward demo test
2026 Q3 negative for selected M30 model; 2025 Q4 contributed most of 2025 gain
One sample cannot guarantee consistent future profitability
